hints.content: We cannot distribute an exponent to a binomial inside parentheses.  That is, $(x-2)^2\neq x^2-2^2$.  In this line he can either take the square root of both sides, or multiply the binomial by itself and then solve for $x$.

question.content:
Mitchell solved a quadratic equation. His work is shown below.

**In which step did Mitchell make an error?**

$\begin{align}
5(x-2)^2+6&=86
\\\\
5(x-2)^2&=80&\text{Step }1
\\\\
(x-2)^2&=16&\text{Step }2
\\\\
x^2-2^2&=16&\text{Step }3
\\\\
x^2&=20&\text{Step }4
\\\\
x&=\pm\sqrt{20}&\text{Step }5
\end{align}$

[[☃ radio 1]]
